view.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall metal shelving units holding boxes and red crates. A large beige air filter unit sits on a pallet in the center. In the background, there's an open doorway, blue trash bins, and more stacked boxes. The space has concrete flooring and industrial lighting.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall gray metal shelving unit on the left, partially obstructing view. Holds wooden pallets and red plastic crates. Red vertical label on side. Appears freestanding, supported by legs. Occluded by foreground elements.

objects.label: beige air filter unit
objects.observation: Large rectangular beige air filter unit with grid pattern, resting on a wooden pallet. Positioned centrally in the aisle. Visible from front and sides. Not touching any other objects directly. Appears freestanding.

objects.label: blue trash bin
objects.observation: Blue plastic trash bin located near the back wall, to the right of the doorway. Standing upright on floor. Partially occluded by shelves and other objects. No visible supports or attachments.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Several red plastic crates stacked on lower shelves of the shelving unit. Located on the left side of the frame. Some are partially obscured by other items. Resting on shelf surface, supported by it.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Wooden pallets stacked on top of the shelving unit and on the floor. One is under the air filter unit. Made of wood, showing natural grain. Supported by shelves or floor. Some are partially occluded.

objects.label: doorway
objects.observation: Open doorway in the background, framed by yellow curtains. Leads to another area. Located behind the air filter unit. No visible door or frame details. Appears as an opening in the wall.
